osaka_moja_curry_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The shop describes "a rich, slow-cooked roux" (roux is usually thickened with wheat flour), and a hamburg steak is among the toppings.
osaka_moja_curry_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature is curry under sweet-simmered beef, and nothing is described as vegan; the base sauce is not described.
osaka_moja_curry_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–20:00 (Tabelog). No reservations; takeaway orders can be booked (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 7 counter seats, tight enough that a bag on the chair blocks the way (October 2026); non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). Water is self-service; fukujinzuke sits on the counter, and other pickles cost ¥50 (October 2026). Most orders arrive in a minute or so; the hamburg-steak curry takes about 12 minutes (October 2026).
osaka_moja_curry_shin_osaka.notes: [Curry · Shin-Osaka Station, a 7-seat counter in Aji no Koji] A tiny curry counter in the food alley on the ground floor of Shin-Osaka Station, on Tabelog's Curry WEST 100 list in 2023, 2024 and 2026, with signed celebrity photos on the wall. Its curry was created by a chef from Bangladesh, and "moja" means delicious in Bengali (October 2026). Most diners order the negi beef curry: thin beef simmered sweet, a pile of crunchy green onion, and a smooth sauce that starts sweet and lets the heat build, about ¥1,200–1,300 with the spice level and rice amount to your choice (October 2026). It usually arrives within a minute, which suits a traveller with a Shinkansen to catch. Seven seats only, cramped with luggage; the queue moves fast.

roles: Counter staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.origin: The curry was created by a chef from Bangladesh (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: "The signature dish is a curry created by a chef from Bangladesh, featuring a perfect balance of sweetness and spiciness. 'Moja' means 'delicious' in Bengali." Per the Tabelog listing: a unique blend of spices and a rich, slow-cooked roux, balancing flavour and aroma so that depth comes through the heat. Tabelog Curry WEST 100: 2023, 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: "A curry flavor you'll never forget!" (Tabelog, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Negi beef curry.

anecdotes.text: "I was shocked when my order arrived in just one minute. So fast!" — October 2026, the negi beef curry for JPY 1,200.
"Many customers seem to have a routine of saying, 'When I come to Shin-Osaka Station, I start here and end here.'" — October 2026.
"While waiting for my curry, I noticed many signed photos of celebrities adorning the walls." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: モジャカレー 新大阪本店、カレー、食べログ カレー WEST 百名店 2023・2024・2026、大阪市淀川区西中島5-16-1 JR新大阪駅 1F 味の小路、毎日11:00〜14:30、17:00〜20:00、予約不可 (テイクアウトは予約可)、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、7席 (カウンター)、禁煙、子ども可、テイクアウト。店の紹介: 独自のスパイスとじっくり煮込んだルーの Mojya Curry、辛さの中にも深み、トッピングでお好みに。口コミ(2026年10月): ネギビーフカレー1,200〜1,300円、BIG ハンバーグカレー1,400円、辛さとごはんの量を選べる、約1分で出てくる、なめらかでさらっとしたルー、甘くてあとから辛い、Bangladesh 出身の料理人が考えたカレー、Moja は Bengali で「おいしい」、壁に有名人のサイン、福神漬けはカウンターに、水はセルフ、せまいカウンター。

osaka_rokumonsen_nishimiyahara.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles; the sets add fried rice, Tianjin rice or rice balls.
osaka_rokumonsen_nishimiyahara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: ramen with chashu in soy, salt, miso or tonkotsu broths; one diner found a rich pork-bone broth (August 2026).
osaka_rokumonsen_nishimiyahara.hours_raw: Tabelog's hours grid: Mon–Fri 10:45–21:00, Sat 10:45–15:00, closed Sunday. The listing's own note says otherwise: Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and from 18:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–21:00; closed 31 December–3 January. Hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; no cards; e-money accepted; no QR payment (Tabelog). 15 seats at a counter and tables; non-smoking; takeaway; children welcome (Tabelog). A line at weekday noon (May and August 2026); food comes fast (April and September 2026). Open since 1982 and now run by the second generation (an August 2026 review).
osaka_rokumonsen_nishimiyahara.notes: [Ramen · Nishimiyahara, a 1982 ramen-and-fried-rice counter] A small local ramen shop a few minutes' walk from the north exit of Shin-Osaka Station, open since 1982 and now in its second generation (August 2026), with red uniforms and a red sign that one diner tied to the Sanada clan's red armour behind the name (May 2026). The bowls are plain and old-style: a light shoyu ramen with thin straight noodles, bean sprouts and a dab of spicy miso to stir in, or shio, miso and tonkotsu, mostly ordered as a ¥1,100–1,200 set with a half portion of fried rice that is nearly a full one (2026). Office workers line up at noon, food comes fast, and the staff chat with everyone (May 2026). Diners call it ordinary in the best sense: nothing showy, easy to eat every day.

roles: Second-generation owner (unnamed) and counter staff
chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Per an August 2026 review: "it was established quite a while ago, in 1982, and is currently run by the second generation." A May 2026 diner: "The staff were very chatty, engaging in conversation with various customers," and the uniforms and sign are red.
chef_bio.specialty: Shoyu ramen with half fried rice.

anecdotes.text: "The staff were very chatty, engaging in conversation with various customers. It was the first time I had seen someone talk so much in a ramen shop! (laughs)" — May 2026, the half-chan ramen.
"Although it was a half portion of fried rice, it was surprisingly substantial, close to a regular serving." — August 2026, the half-chan ramen for JPY 1,200.
"Above all, I was amazed by the speed of service." — September 2026, a Saturday lunch of shoyu ramen and mini Tianjin rice.

osaka_sake_yashima_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Small home-style dishes, spice curries, chicken tempura and a Thursday pasta are on the menu; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_sake_yashima_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Ask. Nothing is labelled vegan or vegetarian. The spice curry of lotus root and beans (July 2026) and the bean-and-vegetable curry plate (June 2026) may suit, but neither is described as meat- or fish-free, and most side dishes include meat or fish.
osaka_sake_yashima_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon and Sat 12:00–18:00; Wed, Thu and Fri 12:00–21:30; closed Tue and Sun (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (AMEX only), e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 18 seats: a counter downstairs and tables on the second floor (May and July 2026); non-smoking; private hire (Tabelog). Lunch can be slow with two staff: one July 2026 diner waited 40 minutes. Sake events now and then (May 2026). Opened 6 January 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_sake_yashima_nishinakajima.notes: [Sake bar · Nishinakajima, daytime drinking by Shin-Osaka] A daytime sake bar a few minutes from Shin-Osaka Station, marked by a giant sake bottle out front, opened in 2021 to serve sake from noon: over 50 kinds, poured in 45, 60 or 90 ml so you can try several, cold or warmed in the warmer on the counter, and the owner chose a kanzake for one May 2026 diner. The food is light and home-style: ¥1,000–1,300 lunch plates of small side dishes and a half portion of spice curry over brown rice, heavy on beans and lotus root, or a ¥1,500 "Hirunomi Set" that comes with two small sakes (2026). One business traveller stopped in for lunch and two small sakes before the Shinkansen back to Nagoya (May 2026). Two people run it, so lunch can be slow, 40 minutes on one July 2026 day; come with time to spare. Thursdays bring the chef's pasta.

roles: Owner (unnamed) who chooses the warm sakes, and one other staff member
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: a daytime sake specialist at the gateway to Osaka, with healthy lunches and spice curry and over 50 sakes chosen to go with the side dishes, served warm from lunchtime; opened 6 January 2021. Reviewers: the owner chose a kanzake (May 2026); "There were only two staff members, so it took a little while to prepare the food" (May 2026); occasional sake events (May 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Homemade dishes that are gentle on the body," paired with sake (March 2026 review, quoting the shop).
chef_bio.specialty: Kanzake at noon; spice curry; Hirunomi Set.

anecdotes.text: "The standard serving is 90ml, but you can also choose 60ml or 45ml, which is great for those who want to try a variety." — March 2026.
"While chilled sake is great, it's wonderful to find a place that serves delicious kanzake." — May 2026, the JPY 1,500 lunch set with two sakes before a Shinkansen back to Nagoya.
"I entered the restaurant at 12:15 PM, but my food was served at 12:55 PM." — July 2026, the combination spice curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 新大阪昼呑み酒場 SAKE ヤシマ、居酒屋・日本酒バー、大阪市淀川区西中島7-9-15、月・土12:00〜18:00、水・木・金12:00〜21:30、火・日休み、予約可、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、18席、禁煙、貸切可、2021年1月6日オープン。店の紹介: 新大阪駅からすぐの昼から日本酒の店、体にやさしいランチとスパイスカレー、昼からお燗、おかずに合う50種以上の日本酒。口コミ(2026年3月〜10月): Midosuji 線7番出口から約3分、90ml、60ml、45ml、日替わり定食1,000円、日替わり2品と半分のスパイスカレーと玄米の御膳1,300円、ピーマンの肉詰め、ハンバーグ、レンコンと豆のカレー、白身魚のかぶと煮、日本酒2杯つきの昼呑みセット1,500円、サバのグリーンカレーとレンコンと豆のドライキーマ、とり天、木曜はシェフのパスタ、サンマのパスタ、Omi の牛すじと赤こんにゃくの卯の花、Kitajima の日本酒、店主が選ぶお燗、2階にテーブル、日本酒のイベント、スタッフ2人で昼は時間がかかる、大きな酒瓶の看板。

cultural_comfort.note: Sake by the small glass, cold or warmed; lunch sets of small dishes. No English evidence found.

osaka_gojoya_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every skewer is battered and deep-fried (kushikatsu).
osaka_gojoya_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase of fried skewers, mostly meat and seafood (beef, shrimp, eel, scallop, conger, squid with sea-urchin sauce); vegetable skewers come in the same run.
osaka_gojoya_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:30–22:00; closed Sat, Sun and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog), and reviewers advise phoning ahead (April, July and October 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR payment (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥300 (Tabelog's original text: 席料300円). 12 seats at a U-shaped counter; smoking allowed (Tabelog; June 2020). Lunch, once a line-out for pork-cutlet sets, has stopped (a May 2021 review).
osaka_gojoya_nishinakajima.notes: [Kushikatsu · Nishinakajima, a couple's creative skewer counter] A 12-seat U-shaped counter behind a sliding door and a white noren on a back-alley corner near Shin-Osaka, run by a long-serving couple (2020–2021 reviews). There is no menu to choose from: the chef fries small, light-battered skewers one at a time and sets them before you until you say stop, or you take a trial ten for ¥2,500 (2025–2026). The classics are here, beef and shrimp, but people come for the inventions: eel with tofu, okra with bacon and cheese, squid under sea-urchin sauce, kelp with roe, a sweet satoimo dengaku. Four sauces sit on the counter, and each skewer is laid beside the one it should meet. The skewers are small, so some diners leave wanting more (2025). Weekday evenings only; phone ahead. Smoking is allowed.

roles: Chef at the fryer and partner (an unnamed couple)
chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: "The experienced couple running the place provides a warm atmosphere" (June 2020); a long-established kushikatsu restaurant run by a skilled chef and the chef's wife, which used to draw lines for its pork-cutlet lunch sets; the same diner believed lunch had stopped because "the couple is now elderly" (May 2021).
chef_bio.specialty: Creative kushikatsu omakase.

anecdotes.text: "Four types of sauces were placed on the table, and freshly fried skewers were served in a bamboo tube on the counter. You're supposed to place the skewer in the same spot as the sauce you want to use." — July 2025, the trial 10-skewer course for JPY 2,500.
"Before I knew it, I found myself saying, 'One more, one more,' and ended up completely overindulging, but I have no regrets whatsoever." — October 2025, the omakase.
"The skewer, coated in a thin and delicate batter, is surprisingly light and crispy." — January 2026, the 10-skewer omakase for JPY 2,500.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 五條家、串揚げ、大阪市淀川区西中島7-3-3 末広ハイツ101、JR 新大阪駅から徒歩10分、地下鉄 新大阪駅から6分、月〜金17:30〜22:00、土・日・祝休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、席料300円、12席 (カウンターのみ)、喫煙可。口コミ(2020年6月〜2026年1月): Midosuji 線7番出口の南、路地のかど、白いのれんと串かつのちょうちん、引き戸、U 字のカウンター、ベテランの夫婦が切り盛り、昔は昼のとんかつ定食に行列、今は夜だけ、おまかせのみで「ストップ」まで、お試し10本2,500円、ソースは4種類で串を置く場所で決まる、牛肉、エビ、うなぎと豆腐、鶏むねと山芋、キスと三つ葉、里芋の田楽、オクラとベーコンとチーズ、しめじの肉巻き、ホタテ、穴子、うずら、イカのウニソース、子持ち昆布、豚、ねぎま、もちチーズ、デザートにシャーベットとチョコレートの串、電話で予約がおすすめ、串は小さめ。

osaka_izumisano_katsu_zushi_grand_front.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi and tempura come with flavoured salts (matcha, hojicha, genmaicha, sweet potato) as well as the usual soy sauce, which normally contains wheat; the tempura skewers are wheat-battered.
osaka_izumisano_katsu_zushi_grand_front.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and tempura bar; vegetable tempura (shiitake, onion, corn, lotus root, eggplant) appears in 2026 reviews, fried alongside seafood.
osaka_izumisano_katsu_zushi_grand_front.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00, last order 21:00; closing days follow Grand Front Osaka; hours may change at New Year, Golden Week and Obon (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); easy to get in around 17:00 (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay, PayPay (Tabelog). 20 seats: 14 at the counter and three tables for two; non-smoking (smoking area in the building); children welcome; picture menu; paid parking in the building (Tabelog). Opened 1 March 2026 (Tabelog).
osaka_izumisano_katsu_zushi_grand_front.notes: [Sushi · Umeda, Grand Front Osaka South B1F] The Osaka branch of a Kyoto sushi bar known for queues, opened in March 2026 in the basement of Grand Front Osaka's south building, three minutes from the station. Nigiri start at ¥80 a piece and come dressed for the camera: edible flowers, a different condiment on each piece, and a row of coloured salts from a Kyoto tea shop (matcha, hojicha, genmaicha, sweet potato) for the sushi and the skewered tempura. Sets run about ¥2,700–3,000 for eight or nine pieces, tempura ¥1,050, and lunch sets suit a quick meal. Most 2026 diners liked the look and freshness; one September diner waited over 20 minutes for food, disliked staff working the register in blue gloves, and judged it aimed at visitors. Counter seats suit solo diners.

roles: Sushi chefs (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.origin: Second shop of a popular Kyoto sushi restaurant (Tabelog); an affiliated shop is in the Osaka Fukoku Seimei Building (Tabelog remarks).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): fresh seafood from local waters and fishing ports, prepared by skilled chefs, from ¥80 a piece; sake, tempura and side dishes; for sightseers and after-work diners. Opened 1 March 2026. A review describes the concept as "see, eat, and enjoy" sushi (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sushi to see as well as eat (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Flower-topped nigiri with tea salts; skewered tempura.

anecdotes.text: "The matcha salt and hojicha salt made from tea leaves sourced from a tea shop in Kyoto were also impressive." — August 2026.
"What sets this sushi apart is that each piece is topped with a different condiment, making it visually stunning" — September 2026.
"Even though it wasn't busy, it took over 20 minutes from ordering to receiving my food." — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Picture menu (Tabelog); counter seats for solo diners; one diner thought it aimed at overseas visitors (September 2026). No English menu listed.

osaka_kitashinchi_yado.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, seasonal dishes and a sea-bream kamameshi (June 2026) are usually seasoned with soy sauce, which normally contains wheat.
osaka_kitashinchi_yado.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya and course restaurant (sashimi, fugu, sea bream, meat dishes).
osaka_kitashinchi_yado.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); Sat 18:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Sundays, holidays, Golden Week, Obon and New Year (Tabelog). Reservations: the shop phones to confirm the number given; write any end time in the request (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay for bills over ¥4,000; no e-money (Tabelog). 17 seats: counter and private rooms for 4, 6 and 8; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed, including paper cigarettes, with separate smoking rooms in the private rooms (Tabelog; March and June 2026); a December 2025 diner at the counter was bothered by the smoke. Opened 9 July 2018 (Tabelog).
osaka_kitashinchi_yado.notes: [Izakaya · Kitashinchi, fish at the top of the station stairs] A small third-floor izakaya right at the top of the stairs from Kitashinchi station, with a counter and private rooms. The chef, trained at well-known Japanese restaurants, buys fish at the market each morning, so the sashimi platters (fugu on one March 2026 visit) change daily, and there is a sea-bream kamameshi to finish. Courses with all-you-can-drink start at about ¥7,000–7,500; à la carte is extensive. Diners praise the fish and the attentive staff; others found prices high, drinks slow (May 2026), and the counter smoky, since smoking is allowed. Open until midnight on weekdays; closed Sundays and holidays.

roles: Chef (unnamed), trained at well-known Japanese restaurants (Tabelog)
Owner (unnamed; "working efficiently", December 2025 review)

osaka_kitashinchi_yakitori_kawaguchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakitori may be salted or brushed with tare, which is usually soy-based and contains wheat; ask for salt. The meal often ends with grilled rice-ball chazuke.
osaka_kitashinchi_yakitori_kawaguchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori restaurant built on whole Tamba black chickens.
osaka_kitashinchi_yakitori_kawaguchi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:30–22:00, last order 21:30; closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Same-day bookings welcome, but same-day cancellations are not accepted with only 13 seats; private rooms for four or more by phone only; call if Tabelog shows full (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 13 seats at the counter plus private rooms (Tabelog). Smoking: allowed per Tabelog; only in the private rooms per a September 2025 review. Opened 21 February 2017 (Tabelog).
osaka_kitashinchi_yakitori_kawaguchi.notes: [Yakitori · Kitashinchi, Tamba black chicken] A thirteen-seat yakitori counter with private rooms, up in a building opposite the Karaoke Kan by Kitashinchi station, that butchers whole Tamba black chickens each day so it can serve rare cuts and even raw white liver. Order the omakase course or à la carte (skewers from about ¥350, seared seseri or thigh tataki); diners single out the daki-mi, the tsukune and the liver, and nearly everyone ends with the grilled rice-ball chazuke. Expect ¥10,000–15,000 a head with drinks. Diners describe a friendly owner and bright staff, and in September 2026 a young chef at the grill; a few earlier diners found service brisk or skewers coming too fast. Weekdays only.

roles: Owner (unnamed; "very friendly", September 2025 review)
Grill chef (unnamed; "relatively young", September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): authentic yakitori; each Tamba black chicken prepared individually from the whole bird; "Only Kawaguchi Offers White Liver Sashimi from Kyo-Tanba Black Chicken!"; the shop is only in Kitashinchi and unrelated to similarly named shops. Opened 21 February 2017.
chef_bio.philosophy: Whole birds prepared in house for rare cuts (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Tamba black chicken yakitori; white liver sashimi; grilled rice-ball chazuke.

osaka_kushikatsu_eshezo_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kushikatsu of wagyu, seafood, abalone and foie gras alongside vegetables, all in the same oil.
osaka_kushikatsu_eshezo_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Kushikatsu 17:00–23:00, last kushikatsu order 21:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations recommended (counter only, full on a March 2026 Friday); a booking may be cancelled after 30 minutes without a call (Tabelog). Non-smoking 17:00–22:00 (22:30 in another note), ashtray at the door; smoking allowed after that (Tabelog). Bring-your-own cake free; private wine events for 10–13 with ¥1,100 corkage; private lunch hire 13:00–16:00 for 4–5 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 11 counter seats; children welcome; dislikes and allergies asked (Tabelog). Opened 28 September 2016 (Tabelog).
osaka_kushikatsu_eshezo_kitashinchi.notes: [Kushikatsu · Kitashinchi, an eleven-seat counter with a big drinks list] A second-floor kushikatsu counter a minute from Nishi-Umeda station, where every staff member is a sommelier and the all-you-can-drink runs to about a hundred wines and sakes, rare bottles included. Skewers of western-Japan produce (Nara pork, Awaji onion, Ehime sea bream, black wagyu, abalone, foie gras) come fresh from cottonseed oil in a thin batter, with five sauces and unlimited cabbage, and courses end with sushi, olive somen and ice cream. Courses run about ¥5,000–8,800; a 10th-anniversary 15-skewer course was ¥4,950 in autumn 2026. Diners call it a place they return to; one September 2026 diner found little for non-drinkers beyond oolong tea. Counter only, so book. Smoking allowed late in the evening.

roles: Owner (unnamed; "Owner's Recommendation" courses, Tabelog)
Staff, all sommeliers (Tabelog)

osaka_hamac_de_paradis_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The signature is a breaded cream croquette with demi-glace, and lunches come with bread or rice; pasta and cakes fill much of the menu.
osaka_hamac_de_paradis_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog marks vegetarian options, but there is no vegan information; the croquette is a cream filling and most plates use meat or fish.
osaka_hamac_de_paradis_minamisenba.hours_raw: Daily: lunch 11:30–15:00, dinner 17:00–21:00, café and drinks 11:30–21:30 (last orders), closing 22:00 (official site); Tabelog gives dinner from 17:30. Open year-round (Tabelog). Lunch can be booked only at weekends and holidays for 11:30–12:00; seat-only bookings are limited to 90 minutes when busy; café-only visits cannot be booked (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay (Tabelog). 112 seats: 42 at tables on 1F and 2F around an atrium, a 10-seat counter, and a 3F sofa room for up to 60–70 with karaoke and a projector for private hire; non-smoking (Tabelog). Since 1995 (official site).
osaka_hamac_de_paradis_minamisenba.notes: [Bistro and café · Minami-Senba, the croquette lunch] A big, long-running Minami-Senba bistro and café open since 1995, black and white with modern art, mosaic tiles and a striking 'Dear Ingo' lamp, with a counter and tables around a two-storey atrium. Lunch is what fills it with nearby office workers: the house croquette, crisp outside and creamy with mushrooms and porcini, under demi-glace, with fresh-baked bread or rice and a salad with a homemade dressing for ¥1,200 (October 2026). Evenings bring a seasonal bistro menu with more than 50 wines, mainly Italian, and party courses; a third-floor sofa room with karaoke takes groups. Daily events (a free drink one day, Halloween candy for a password another) are posted on Instagram. One diner found the portions small but the cooking careful (September 2026).

Tabelog: featured on the TV show "Gochi ni Narimasu!" on 20 April 2023; over 50 wines, mainly Italian. A diner in October 2026 mentions sister restaurants.

osaka_cafe_charbon_kitahorie.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Lunches come with bread (refills) or rice, and the mains are pasta, pizza, risotto and sauced meats; the salad bar is the plainest part.
osaka_cafe_charbon_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The lunch salad bar has fresh vegetables and vegetable obanzai with soup; the mains are meat, fish, cheese and cream.
osaka_cafe_charbon_kitahorie.hours_raw: Sun–Thu and holidays 11:30–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); Fri, Sat and nights before holidays 11:30–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); lunch menu until 14:30, then the café menu; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, but not for café-only visits at lunch or dinner time; groups by phone (Tabelog); some weekend days are booked out for parties (September 2026). No cover charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 65 seats with sofa seats and a private room; private hire up to 100 seated (weddings, reunions); non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Ordering by QR code (October 2026). Opened 8 December 1999 (Tabelog).
osaka_cafe_charbon_kitahorie.notes: [Café · Kitahorie, a converted lumber warehouse] One of the long-running cafés of the Horie side of Shinsaibashi, open since 1999 in a renovated timber warehouse with an eight-metre ceiling, exposed wooden beams, big windows and candlelight at night, a minute from Yotsubashi Station. Lunch is the value: pick a main (hashed pork, a daily special, pasta, risotto or pizza) and help yourself to a salad bar of fresh vegetables, obanzai and soup, with bread, rice and homemade jams; the hashed pork was ¥1,000 in September 2026, and a ¥2,500 lunch course adds a drink, an appetizer plate and dessert. In the afternoon it is a café for a latte and cake; at night it books out for parties and even weddings. Ordering is by QR code; one diner disliked that and the rushed payment, another found the steak average (October 2026).

roles: Kitchen and café staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a stylish, long-established café of the Shinsaibashi and Horie area, a renovated lumber warehouse with an 8 m ceiling and wooden interior lit by candles at night; menus centred on Italian cooking; private hire for weddings, reunions and company events. Opened 8 December 1999.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch with a salad bar; pasta and risotto.

anecdotes.text: "The meal came with a salad bar, which had a decent variety of options, along with soup ... There were also three types of jam available for unlimited servings." — September 2026, hashed pork lunch ¥1,000.
"The exposed wooden beams on the ceiling create a retro and warm space." — October 2026, an evening drink.
"Just be careful not to get too caught up in the appetizers, or the carbonara might get cold!" — September 2026, a regular.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): カフェ シャルボン (CAFE CHARBON)、カフェ・イタリアン・バー、大阪市西区北堀江1-6-23、四ツ橋駅4番出口から徒歩1分、日〜木・祝11:30〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00)、金・土・祝前日11:30〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00)、ランチは14:30 L.O.、その後はカフェメニュー、不定休、予約可 (ランチとディナーの時間はカフェのみの予約不可、団体は電話で)、チャージなし、カード・Suica・PayPay 可、65席、貸切は着席100名まで、禁煙、Wi-Fi、誕生日のデザートプレート1,500円、1999年12月8日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 心斎橋・堀江の老舗のおしゃれなカフェ、材木倉庫を改装した天井8メートルの空間、夜はキャンドル、イタリアンを中心にしたコース、結婚式の二次会や同窓会も。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): メインを選んで前菜とサラダバー、スープは食べ放題、ハッシュドポーク1,000円とパン、3種のジャム、木曜の日替わりは豚キムチ、パスタ、ピザ、リゾット、ステーキ、スマートランチコース2,500円、ラテアート、ティラミス、QR コードで注文、週末は貸切の日も、会計を急かされたという声。

osaka_taiseikaku_higashishinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Cantonese and Sichuan dishes with soy and oyster sauces, dumplings, noodles and battered fried dishes.
osaka_taiseikaku_higashishinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese set meals and banquets of pork, seafood and chicken.
osaka_taiseikaku_higashishinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (food last order 20:45, drinks 21:00); New Year (3 January), Obon (13–15 August) and Golden Week 11:00–22:00 straight; closed 30 December–2 January (Tabelog). Takeaway daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–20:30, ordered ahead by phone or fax; Uber Eats and Demae-can (Tabelog). Reservations by the day before; private rooms need a course (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). Six floors, about 1,500 seats, up to 400 on one floor; private rooms for 2 to over 30, tatami and sofa rooms, karaoke; non-smoking with a smoking room on 2F; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; discount at the partner car park (Tabelog). Founded 1953, per the listing (the Tabelog opening-day field reads 12 October 1958).
osaka_taiseikaku_higashishinsaibashi.notes: [Chinese · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, six floors since the 1950s] A Higashi-Shinsaibashi landmark of Chinese cooking for over 70 years, six floors and some 1,500 seats of Showa-modern Chinese decor, two minutes from Shinsaibashi Station. It is busiest at lunch, when ¥1,100 buys a set of sweet-and-sour pork, mapo tofu or another main with refills of rice and soup, salad, pickles, free congee and self-service coffee, and sweet-potato snacks while they last. In the evening the floors fill with banquets, weddings and reunions; à la carte runs to crab fried rice (¥1,320) and Hong Kong-style chili prawns (¥1,980). Diners in 2026 call it good value and nostalgic; one returning after ten years found it neither good nor bad. Takeaway and delivery too.

roles: Kitchen and banquet staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: founded in 1953 and marking its 70th anniversary; six versatile floors for one person up to about 400, used for lunch, banquets, year-end and New Year parties, reunions, concerts and weddings; featured on TV and in magazines; an online shop (taiseikaku.easy-myshop.jp). The Tabelog opening-day field gives 12 October 1958. Diners in 2026 describe coming since childhood and a Showa-modern interior.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets with free congee; banquet courses.

anecdotes.text: "For just JPY 1000 (tax included JPY 1100), you can choose a main Chinese dish, with all-you-can-eat rice, soup, salad, and pickles included." — September 2026.
"A long-established Chinese restaurant located just a short walk from Shinsaibashi Station, which I've been visiting since childhood!" — August 2026.
"As soon as the tea was placed on the table, they served the 'porridge.'" — October 2026, the matsutake ramen set ¥2,310.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 中国料理 大成閣 (タイセイカク)、中華料理・飲茶、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-12、心斎橋駅5・6番出口から徒歩2分、毎日11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.20:45)、12月30日〜1月2日休み、テイクアウト (電話・FAX で予約)、Uber Eats と Demae-can、予約は前日まで、個室はコースのみ、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、約1,500席 (1フロア400名まで)、6フロア、個室、座敷、ソファ席、カラオケ、禁煙 (2階に喫煙室)、車いす可、Wi-Fi、提携駐車場の割引。店の紹介 (英訳): 1953年創業、70周年、テレビや雑誌でも紹介、ランチ、宴会、忘年会、新年会、同窓会、コンサート、結婚式、オンラインショップ。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): ランチ1,000円 (税込1,100円) でご飯・スープ・サラダ・漬物はおかわり自由、お粥とコーヒーはセルフでサービス、さつまいものお菓子、酢豚の定食1,100円、松茸ラーメンとチャーハンのセット2,310円、担々麺と水餃子、カニチャーハン1,320円、麻婆豆腐1,100円、エビチリ1,980円、海鮮炒め1,870円、昭和モダンの雰囲気、子どものころから通う、良くも悪くもないという声。

osaka_minami_no_jucchu_hakku_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Signatures include a breaded rare salmon fry and crab gratin, with tempura, oden and sashimi with soy sauce.
osaka_minami_no_jucchu_hakku_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; oden and appetizers are in dashi.
osaka_minami_no_jucchu_hakku_namba.hours_raw: Sun–Thu, holidays and the day after 17:00–01:00; Fri, Sat and nights before holidays 17:00–02:00 (Tabelog). Reservations recommended, often full (2026 reviews); a 2-hour limit when busy; a booking may be cancelled if you are 15 minutes late without contact; groups and private hire by phone (Tabelog). A walk-in on a holiday had 50 minutes to last order (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 40 seats over 1F and 2F with a counter and sofa seats; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Menus in English, simplified Chinese and Korean, with photos (Tabelog). Opened 16 March 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_minami_no_jucchu_hakku_namba.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Namba, a minute from the station] A busy two-floor seafood izakaya in the back streets a minute from Namba Station, part of a small group whose main shop is a fish shop in Fukushima, open until 1 a.m. (2 a.m. at weekends) and hard to get into without a booking. The two dishes everyone orders are the seafood yukhoe plate and the salmon fried rare under sauce and condiments; then crab gratin crowned with crab legs, grilled tuna cheek, oden, horse sashimi in broth or a potato salad you mash yourself, with plenty of sake. Diners in 2026 praised the prices, the freshness and the fast, friendly staff; one found the sashimi platter and beer small for the money (October 2026). Menus in English, Chinese and Korean.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a casual eatery and tavern of fresh seafood and Japanese sake in the back streets of Namba; part of the Jucchu Hakku group with Fish Shop Jucchu Hakku Fukushima Main Store, Ohatsu no Jucchu Hakku and a bar in Fukushima (names as on the English listing). Opened 16 March 2023.
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood yukhoe plate; salmon rare fry.

anecdotes.text: "The highlight was the grilled tuna cheek—so tender and melt-in-your-mouth delicious." — October 2026.
"The Salmon Rare Fry was generously topped with sauce and condiments. The Gratin was impressively presented with crab legs" — October 2026, on a trip to Osaka.
"Even around 9 PM, it was fully booked. I think it's quite difficult to walk in without a reservation." — September 2025, a repeat visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): みなみの十忠八九 (ミナミノジュッチュウハック)、居酒屋・海鮮・日本酒バー、大阪市中央区難波4-2-6 トシヒサビル 1F・2F、地下鉄なんば駅から徒歩1分、日〜木・祝17:00〜翌1:00、金・土・祝前日17:00〜翌2:00、予約可 (混雑時は2時間制、15分連絡がないと取り消すことも、団体と貸切は電話で)、カード・PayPay 可、40席、カウンター、ソファ席、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、Wi-Fi、英語・中国語 (簡体字)・韓国語のメニュー、写真つき、2023年3月16日オープン、グループ店は Fish Shop Jucchu Hakku Fukushima Main Store、Ohatsu no Jucchu Hakku など。店の紹介 (英訳): なんばの裏通りの鮮魚と日本酒の大衆食堂・酒場、名物は海鮮ユッケ盛りとサーモンのレアフライ、日本酒飲み放題つきの宴会コース4,000〜8,000円。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): サーモンのレアカツ、海鮮ユッケ、カニのグラタン、マグロのほほ肉の焼き物、おでん、だしに漬けた馬刺し、自分でつぶすポテトサラダ、鱧の天ぷら、海鮮の釜飯、お通しのカニみそ豆腐、いつも満席なので予約を、スタッフが親切で早い、刺身の盛り合わせとビールが値段のわりに小さいという声。

osaka_lobby_cafe_fascino_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu is cakes and tarts, pancakes, sandwiches, omurice and salad lunches; nothing is stated about wheat.
osaka_lobby_cafe_fascino_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream cakes, tarts and pancakes; nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_lobby_cafe_fascino_namba.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed when Osaka Takashimaya is closed; holidays such as Christmas, New Year and Golden Week follow the weekend plan (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, e.g. for the lunch set (October 2026); lines at weekend afternoons (November 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, Rakuten Edy and iD, and QR (PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY) (Tabelog). 100 seats, many on sofas; non-smoking; children welcome; takeout (Tabelog). Opened 2 March 2010 (Tabelog).
osaka_lobby_cafe_fascino_namba.notes: [Café · Namba, big fruit tarts in Takashimaya's restaurant lobby] A large hotel-lounge-style café full of sofas on the seventh floor of Takashimaya's Namba Dining Maison, open until 10 pm. The cakes are the point: tall seasonal fruit tarts (Shine Muscat, peach, fig, chestnut in autumn 2026), Mont Blanc, cheese tart and a strawberry shortcake one diner called huge, and the Kahala hotel's thin, crêpe-like pancakes, which bring one regular back once or twice a year. There is a lunch with salad, soup and a slice of cake (¥2,500) and a dessert buffet. Prices are hotel-level, and in October 2026 one diner found the lunch salad small and the cake slice thin, another the service stretched.

roles: Operator and staff unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: Opened 2 March 2010 (Tabelog), in Takashimaya Osaka's Namba Dining Maison; its official page (rtg.jp) refused access when read. Reviewers come back for the fruit tarts and for the Kahala hotel's pancakes served here (2025–2026); one found the staff guided a solo diner kindly to a sofa (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fruit tarts; Kahala-hotel pancakes.

anecdotes.text: "I visit this place once or twice a year because I can enjoy the famous Shimpancake from Kahala Hotel here." — October 2026.
"The fruit tart was consistently delicious, and the Mont Blanc had a hint of liqueur, giving it a more sophisticated flavor." — November 2026, a sixth visit.
"The taste was delicious, but I was surprised by the small portion of the salad and the thinness of the cake." — October 2026, salad lunch ¥2,500.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): LOBBY CAFE FASCINO、カフェ・ケーキ・ビュッフェ、難波5-1-18 なんばダイニングメゾン 7F、なんば駅から徒歩5分、毎日10:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、大阪高島屋の休館日は休み、クリスマス・年末年始・ゴールデンウィークは土日祝のプラン、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、100席、ソファ席、禁煙、子ども可、テイクアウト、モーニング、デザートビュッフェ、オープン2010年3月2日、ホテルのラウンジのような空間。口コミ(2025年11月〜2026年11月): Shine Muscat、桃、いちじくのタルト、いちじくと栗のタルト、ハーフサイズで2種、フルーツタルトとモンブラン、チーズタルト、紅茶のロールケーキ、いちごのショートケーキ、Kahala Hotel のパンケーキ (Shimpancake)、クレープのよう、サラダランチ2,500円 (サラダ、スープ、パン、飲み物、ケーキ)、オムライス、ミックスサンド、夜10時まで、日曜の午後は行列、値段はホテル並み、サラダが少なくケーキが薄いという声、スタッフが少ないという声。

osaka_yakiniku_kinashi_higashishinsaibas.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Cuts come with sauce or salt, and the menu has yukgaejang, cold noodles and other noodles; nothing is stated about wheat.
osaka_yakiniku_kinashi_higashishinsaibas.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a black-wagyu yakiniku restaurant; namul, kimchi and grilled vegetables are sides.
osaka_yakiniku_kinashi_higashishinsaibas.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–02:00 (Tabelog). Reservations recommended (most guests book, October 2026); same-day cancellations by phone at least 2 hours ahead; children under 12 by phone booking only; 1 hour 45 minutes when busy (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC and QUICPay, PayPay (Tabelog). 28 seats with a counter; hire for 20–50; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 3 March 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_yakiniku_kinashi_higashishinsaibas.notes: [Yakiniku · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, thick-cut wagyu late into the night] A lively third-floor yakiniku room near Shinsaibashi Station, opened in 2024, open until 2 am every night and usually full of bookings, its walls already covered in signed photos. Cuts are notably thick: the special premium salted tongue grilled with spices, outside skirt and loin, plus fresh grilled liver that diners single out, raw heart and omasum, and a clay-pot rice. The young staff serve fast and are easy to call over. One regular on a third visit (October 2026) recommends it to anyone craving yakiniku in Minami; one October 2026 diner's order went missing on a busy night. Smoking is allowed.

roles: Owner and staff unnamed; a young team (October 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 March 2024 (Tabelog), selling carefully selected black wagyu at reasonable prices with clay-pot rice (Tabelog shop text). Diners describe mostly young, friendly staff, very fast service, many signed photos of celebrities on the walls, and a fully booked room (2026). An October 2026 diner came on another yakiniku owner's recommendation.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick-cut tongue; premium kalbi; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "The grilled items, including special premium salt tongue, special outside skirt, premium loin, premium mountain chain tripe, and local chicken thigh, were undoubtedly top quality. The fresh grilled liver was incredibly tender!" — October 2026, a third visit.
"The highlight here is undoubtedly the thickly sliced tongue, which is tender and packed with flavor that intensifies with each bite." — September 2026.
"The owner of the yakiniku restaurant mentioned that this place is really great, so I decided to check it out right away." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Yakiniku Kinashi、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、東心斎橋1-19-5 ウィステリア心斎橋ビル 3F、心斎橋駅から徒歩3分、毎日17:00〜翌2:00、当日キャンセルは2時間前までに電話、12歳未満の子どもは電話予約のみ、混雑時は1時間45分制、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、28席、貸切20〜50名、喫煙可、オープン2024年3月3日。店の説明: 厳選した黒毛和牛をリーズナブルに、脂と赤身のバランス、五ツ星お米マイスターのブレンドの銀シャリを土鍋で、名物は厚切りタンと上カルビ。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 特上塩タン、特上ハラミ、上ロース、上ミノ、地鶏のもも、生レバーの焼き、厚切りのタンとロース、リブロース、ロース・ヘレ・カイノミの盛り合わせ、ホルモンミックス、ハツの sashimi、生センマイ、焼き Yukhoe、アボカドキムチ、namul、kakuteki、きのこの namul、厚い長芋と焼き芋、青唐辛子の料理、Yukgaejang、冷麺、牛脂、壁にサイン、若いスタッフ、早い、予約でいっぱい、注文が通っていなかったという声。

osaka_orange_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu has quiche, gratin, fritters, spring rolls, baguette and focaccia, alongside carpaccio, grilled fish and meat; nothing is stated about wheat.
osaka_orange_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a French bistro of seafood, pâté, duck and beef; nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_orange_shinmachi.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 18:00–24:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Monday, sometimes open on holiday Mondays (Tabelog lists the times one minute past the hour). Reservations for two or more; five or more by phone, best called 14:00–17:00; 2½ hours per table; seat-only bookings order at least one drink and one dish each; same-day cancellations charged in full for courses and ¥4,500 a head for seats (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 28 seats: 4 at the counter, 24 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 15 November 2005 (Tabelog).
osaka_orange_shinmachi.notes: [French · Shinmachi, bistro plates with wine and Maruefu draught] A small, calm French bistro and wine bar near Yotsubashi, open since 2005 and until midnight. It makes a point of beer as much as wine: Asahi Maruefu from a Showa-era server, poured four ways, one pour to three pours and mild, so you can taste the difference. The food is à la carte French to share: thick scallop carpaccio, a meat-appetizer plate whose liver pâté won over a liver-hater (July 2026), quiche, corn fritters, sea bass in cream, red-wine-braised wagyu cheek, and a focaccia baked ten a day. Wines by the glass run from sparkling to orange. Handy after a show at the nearby Orix Theater, as several diners note; one diner wondered whether the owner was working alone on a busy September 2026 night.

roles: Owner and kitchen unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: Opened 15 November 2005 (Tabelog). Per the Tabelog shop text, "French cuisine isn't just about wine": Maruefu draught from a Showa-era server poured four ways, with carefully chosen wines and gastronomic dishes for drinking. A regular on a fourth visit missed a two-person course with lobster that had been dropped (July 2026, November 2025). A September 2026 diner wondered whether the owner was managing everything alone.
chef_bio.philosophy: "French cuisine isn't just about wine!" (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Maruefu draught in four pours; scallop carpaccio; red-wine-braised wagyu cheek.

anecdotes.text: "For my first drink, I had a beer poured right in front of me from the tap. The smoothness and crispness of Maru Efu was absolutely fantastic!" — August 2026, after a concert at Kyocera Dome.
"The liver pâté from the assorted meat appetizers was so good that even my friend, who usually dislikes liver, enjoyed it." — July 2026.
"Especially, the Wagyu cheek meat braised in red wine was incredibly tender and flavorful." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): orange、フレンチ・ワインバー・イタリアン、新町1-23-3 誠和ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅2番出口から徒歩3分、心斎橋駅3番出口から徒歩5分、火〜金18:00〜24:00、土日祝17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、月曜休み (祝日は営業することも)、予約は2名から、5名以上は電話で (14〜17時がつながりやすい)、2時間半制、席のみの予約は1人1ドリンク1品、当日キャンセルはコース100%・席のみ1人4,500円、カード・PayPay可、28席 (カウンター4、テーブル24)、禁煙、オープン2005年11月15日。店の説明: フレンチはワインだけじゃない、昭和のビールサーバーのマルエフを一度注ぎ・二度注ぎ・三度注ぎ・まろやか注ぎの4通りで、フランス中心のワインをグラスかボトルで、飲み放題プラン6,500円 (税込) から。口コミ(2025年7月〜2026年10月): 帆立のカルパッチョ、肉の前菜盛り合わせのレバーパテ、キッシュ、とうもろこしのフリット、春巻き、いんげんときのこのサラダ、砂肝のコンフィのクリームソース、スズキのクリームソース、鮮魚のポワレ、ノルウェーサーモンのレアフライ、鴨、和牛ほほ肉の赤ワイン煮、ブルーチーズのグラタン、海老のアヒージョ、チーズ3種盛り、1日10個のフォカッチャ (予約で取り置き)、メニューにない4種ほどのデザート、桃のコンポート、スパークリング・白・オレンジ・赤のグラスワイン、Orix Theater の帰りに、ひとりで切り盛りしているのかという声、2人用のコースがなくなって残念という常連。

osaka_okuwo_namba_sennichimae.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-tongue, wagyu and pork dishes, and the vegetable skewers are wrapped in pork belly.
osaka_okuwo_namba_sennichimae.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); open all year except 31 December 2026 to 4 January 2027 (Tabelog; official site, which closes for New Year and Obon). Reservations accepted; seat and private-room requests by phone (Tabelog). Table charge ¥550 per person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), PayPay and au PAY; no e-money (Tabelog). 47 seats: a 17-seat counter and 30 at tables, all table seats in private rooms for 3–16; heated tobacco only (Tabelog). Opened 1 April 2017 (Tabelog).
osaka_okuwo_namba_sennichimae.notes: [Izakaya · Sennichimae, beef-tongue shabu-shabu and vegetable-wrapped skewers] A stylish izakaya in a traditional-house style near Namba Station, with a long 17-seat counter and every table in a private room, from 株式会社おくお, which brings Kyushu food to Osaka. The dish people come back for is the marbled beef-tongue shabu-shabu (¥4,400 a serving in June 2026): thin slices swished in a kombu broth and wrapped around plenty of green onion. Around it: Fukuoka-style vegetable skewers wrapped in pork belly, tongue sashimi, sushi and thick-cut grilled tongue, a black-wagyu motsunabe, and courses from ¥12,500 that add uni yukke and A5 wagyu. One September 2026 diner found the closing tongue hot pot bland; another regular finds the appetizer never changes and the skewers average. Heated tobacco is allowed.

roles: Operator: 株式会社おくお (official site); kitchen unnamed
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2017 (Tabelog). Per the official site, 株式会社おくお runs restaurants mainly in Kansai and Osaka under the line "Kyushu flavours in Kansai too!", and lists this izakaya, a lunch shop at the same address and a shop in Minami-Honmachi. Diners describe smiling, attentive service and a calm atmosphere (2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Always delicious, ever more fun" (おいしいをずっと、楽しいをもっと; official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Marbled beef-tongue shabu-shabu; vegetable-wrapped skewers; black-wagyu motsunabe.

anecdotes.text: "When I quickly dipped it in the broth, the perfect amount of fat melted away, and with each bite, the umami spread throughout my mouth." — June 2026, marbled beef-tongue shabu-shabu ¥4,400.
"The broth, infused with kombu kelp, is incredibly delicious, and I find myself coming back regularly." — October 2026.
"I was a bit disappointed with the beef tongue hot pot that came out at the end. The broth was quite bland." — September 2026, course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 株式会社おくお、九州の味を関西でも、関西・大阪エリアを中心に飲食店の運営、千日前1-7-11 上方ビル1F、17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、定休日なし (年末年始とお盆は休み)、店舗一覧には同じ住所のランチの店 (10:30〜14:00、水曜休み) と南本町1-5-14 グルラジビル 1F の店も。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Gyutan to Yasai Makigushi Okuwo Nanba ten、居酒屋・牛タン・もつ鍋、なんば駅・日本橋駅から徒歩5分、毎日17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 料理23:00・ドリンク23:30)、2026年12月31日〜2027年1月4日休み、チャージ550円、カード・PayPay・au PAY可、47席 (カウンター17、テーブル30)、テーブルはすべて個室 (3〜16名)、加熱式たばこのみ、オープン2017年4月1日。店の説明: 霜降り牛タンしゃぶしゃぶ、厚切り牛タン串、福岡発祥の野菜巻き串、黒毛和牛もつ鍋、古民家風。コース (税込): 牛タンしゃぶしゃぶのコース12,500円 (A5和牛の「Nikura」、霜降りタンとうにの Yukke、厚切りの焼きタン、タンのデミグラス煮込み、A5のストリップロイン入りの上タンしゃぶしゃぶ)、A5和牛ストリップロインのすき焼きコース15,000円。口コミ(2024年7月〜2026年10月): 霜降り牛タンしゃぶしゃぶ4,400円、Uniku 770円、霜降りタンの sashimi1,760円、昆布の出汁、ねぎを巻いて、タンの食べ比べ、タンの sushi、炭火焼きのタン、レバー焼き、豚しゃぶ、麻婆豆腐、アスパラなどの野菜巻き串、辛いもつ鍋、和牛の sashimi、笑顔の接客、締めのタン鍋は薄かったという声、お通しがいつも同じという声。

osaka_ryukishin_leo_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken broth with a mussel salt tare (October 2026), chicken and pork chashu.

PayPay and Rakuten Pay; no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 33 seats with a counter; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome (Tabelog); roomy enough for a carry-on suitcase (October 2026). Almost full at 11:30 (October 2026); food comes in about five minutes (September–October 2026). Side rice dishes said to be half price at lunch (September 2026). Opened 28 April 2017 (Tabelog).
osaka_ryukishin_leo_shin_osaka.notes: [Ramen · Shin-Osaka Station, Sakai shio ramen by the platforms] A 33-seat shio ramen shop in アルデ新大阪, the station's second-floor dining area, from the Sakai shio-ramen shop 龍旗信, open from 10:00. The classic bowl is a clear, golden chicken broth with kombu and shiitake and a mussel-salt tare, "light yet surprisingly rich" under a sheen of chicken fat (September 2026), with medium-thick straight noodles; the chicken shio adds tender chicken chashu and a citrus lift for ¥1,350. There is shio tonkotsu, a cold seafood ramen in summer, shio gyoza and kara-age. Fast: food in about five minutes, which suits a tight connection. Some regulars of the Sakai shop find it slipped (October 2026), and one diner noted staff from overseas.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff of 龍旗信 (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: Ryukishin LEO, ramen, gyoza and kara-age in アルデ新大阪, opened 28 April 2017; website ryukishin.com (did not load on 2026-11-01). Per reviews: "a specialty shop for Shio Ramen that originated in Osaka" whose shio ramen "features a broth made from simmering chicken bones, whole chickens, kombu kelp, and dried shiitake mushrooms, combined with a salt sauce that concentrates the umami of natural mussels" (October 2026); "Just like the main store in Sakai, the quality has definitely declined … It was much better when [the shop was] located in Ishizu, Sakai" and "All the staff were foreigners" (October 2026); "The staff provided pleasant service" (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Shio ramen; chicken shio ramen.

anecdotes.text: "The broth had a layer of what seemed to be chicken fat. Though it appeared light, it was surprisingly rich." — September 2026, chicken shio ramen ¥1,350.
"The gyoza arrived in about a minute after I was seated … this place is definitely a friend to busy salarymen." — September 2026.
"I had only 20 minutes before my shinkansen departure … I finished my meal in 3 minutes." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 龍旗信LEO、ラーメン・餃子・からあげ、大阪市淀川区西中島5-16-1 JR新大阪駅 2F アルデ新大阪、毎日10:00〜22:30、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay・楽天ペイ可、33席、禁煙、車いす可、子ども可、2017年4月28日オープン。口コミ(2024年7月〜2026年10月): 入口の券売機、大阪発祥の塩ラーメン専門店、鶏ガラ、丸鶏、昆布、干し椎茸のスープに天然のムール貝のうまみの塩ダレ、澄んだ金色のスープ、鶏塩ラーメン1,350円、鶏チャーシュー、レモンや柑橘の香り、塩とんこつ、とんこつラーメン1,250円、冷やしの魚介ラーメン1,300円、つけ麺はニンニクが強い、中太のストレート麺、もちもち、塩加減はちょうどいい、鶏油が多めという声、料理が早い、Sakai の本店のころのほうがよかったという声、スタッフは外国の人。

osaka_restaurant_yokoo_noren_meguri_shin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef cutlets, fried dashi omelette, beef curry.
osaka_restaurant_yokoo_noren_meguri_shin.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–21:30 (last order 21:10), open all year (Tabelog). Inside the Shinkansen ticket gates: you need a Shinkansen ticket to reach it (Tabelog; August 2026). Phone orders for katsu sandwiches welcome, even a single item (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and transport IC cards; no QR (Tabelog). 5 counter seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome (Tabelog). Takeaway sandwiches and bento for the train (Tabelog). Opened 7 November 2016 (Tabelog).
osaka_restaurant_yokoo_noren_meguri_shin.notes: [Yoshoku · Shin-Osaka Station, beef-katsu sandwiches inside the Shinkansen gates] A five-seat counter and takeaway window in the Osaka Noren Meguri food court inside the Shinkansen gates, the station branch of YOKOO, a yoshoku house in Fukushima since 1971 where the second generation added French training (August 2026). The draw is the thick-cut beef katsu sandwich, tenderloin fried medium-rare in a light coat with a homemade sauce, and the mixed sandwich that pairs it with a deep-fried dashi omelette, an Osaka touch; both travel well as a Shinkansen bento. Beef katsu curry (¥1,880) is the sit-down choice. Prices are station prices: ¥1,180 for four small pieces, ¥1,850 for six. One diner found the frying oil tired late in the day (September 2026).

roles: Station branch staff of Restaurant YOKOO (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a specialty shop for Kansai-style thick-cut beef katsu sandwiches and omurice inside Shin-Osaka Station, with plenty to take away for the Shinkansen; opened 7 November 2016. Per reviews: "this long-established Western-style restaurant has been serving customers since 1971 in Fukushima. This station branch of 'Yokoo' continues the tradition of Western cuisine, enhanced by the second generation who learned French cooking" (August 2026); "Restaurant YOKOO has been serving Western cuisine for over 50 years" near JR Fukushima Station (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Thick-cut beef katsu sandwich; mixed sandwich with fried dashi omelette.

anecdotes.text: "The egg sandwich features a style typical of Osaka, where the fluffy dashi omelet is sandwiched between the bread … the dashi omelet is deep-fried to create a cutlet, which helps prevent the juices from soaking into the bread." — August 2026, mixed sandwich (S) ¥1,180.
"Considering its location inside the Shinkansen ticket gate, the beef cutlet sandwich is definitely one of the highlights of my time at Shin-Osaka." — August 2026.
"The busiest place is Kukuru, followed by Imai, Daruma, and Yamamoto … for some reason, Restaurant YOKOO is quite empty." — September 2026, beef katsu curry.

osaka_negiyaki_yamamoto_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: negiyaki is a wheat batter, finished with soy sauce; yakisoba too.
osaka_negiyaki_yamamoto_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: negiyaki with beef tendon, pork belly or shrimp.
osaka_negiyaki_yamamoto_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–21:30 (last order 21:00) (Tabelog). Inside the Shinkansen ticket gates, in the "Osaka Noren Meguri" food court: find a seat first, then order (August 2025, September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB), e-money and QR such as PayPay (Tabelog; September 2026). About 5–6 counter seats of its own plus shared food-court seats; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). Busy on holiday weekends (September 2026); dishes other than negiyaki can take about 20 minutes (September 2026). Opened 29 September 2011 (Tabelog).
osaka_negiyaki_yamamoto_shin_osaka.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Shin-Osaka Station, Juso negiyaki inside the Shinkansen gates] The station counter of Yamamoto, the negiyaki house from Juso, in the Osaka Noren Meguri food court inside the Shinkansen gates, a last taste of Osaka before the train. Negiyaki is okonomiyaki buried in chopped green onion, crisp outside and soft inside, here with beef tendon and konnyaku and a soy-sauce finish (¥1,350), and there is a special version only at this shop with pork belly, tendon and shrimp. It is lighter than sauced okonomiyaki, though some found it salty (2025–2026). Grab a seat before ordering; at busy times the negiyaki comes fast but other dishes can take 20 minutes (September 2026). One diner found ¥1,350 a little steep (October 2026).

roles: Station branch staff of Negiyaki Yamamoto (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: in the Shinkansen-gate food court "Osaka Noren Meguri", opened 29 September 2011. Per reviews: "the familiar Negiyaki from Yamamoto in Juso … While it may not compare to the original location, it brought back fond memories" (October 2026); "The staff works efficiently and cooks in large quantities, so even if I'm cutting it close to my train, I feel reassured" (September 2026); "The service was friendly" (August 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Beef tendon negiyaki; the station-only special negiyaki.

anecdotes.text: "I tried the special Negiyaki, exclusive to this location. It included pork belly, beef tendon, and shrimp—all in one dish." — September 2026.
"This simple okonomiyaki was grilled with just salt and green onions instead of sauce." — September 2026, the original negiyaki.
"There are only a few tables, so it's best to secure a seat before ordering." — August 2025.

osaka_shugetsu_higashinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki and negiyaki batter, breaded kushikatsu and yakisoba.
osaka_shugetsu_higashinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork okonomiyaki, beef tendon, doteyaki, motsuni; vegetable kushikatsu (lotus root, potato, shiitake, asparagus) exist, but batter and sauce are not described.
osaka_shugetsu_higashinakajima.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 18:00–23:00; Sat 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday and Monday, open on the Sunday of a three-day weekend (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and wise: walk-ins were turned away when full (November 2025). Cash only (Tabelog). 18 seats: 14 at an L-shaped counter and one table for four; whole hire up to 20; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 21 November 1999 (Tabelog).
osaka_shugetsu_higashinakajima.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Shin-Osaka east exit, a one-man teppan and kushikatsu counter] An 18-seat L-shaped counter thirty seconds from the Shin-Osaka east exit, open since 1999, where one cheerful owner fries kushikatsu, grills okonomiyaki and pours drinks alone. Start with kushikatsu, lotus root, sausage or shiitake, served piping hot one at a time with a sauce for one dip, then move to the teppan: fluffy pork or egg okonomiyaki, a slow-cooked negiyaki with chunky green onion, tonpei-yaki, doteyaki, and squid-ink yakisoba to finish. The owner asks where you are from, chats across languages with visitors (one evening, a Taiwanese couple, October 2025) and keeps the room laughing. Book ahead; cash only; smoking allowed.

roles: Owner (unnamed), runs the shop alone (reviews 2025–2026)

osaka_shokudo_pesca_namba.notes: [Izakaya · Namba, Japanese-Italian plates from the PESCA team] Down an alley off Doguya-suji that one diner found almost unsettling to walk, a glass-fronted counter facing an open kitchen, with tables upstairs: the second concept from the people behind the Italian restaurant PESCA, open since April 2024. Plates are small and made for drinking: kadaif-wrapped shrimp with shiso and myoga, seared spear squid with sudachi, prosciutto with fruit and mascarpone, tripe in white miso, then the dishes diners name most, a Hirata Farm tonkatsu with truffle salt, a wagyu roast-beef sukiyaki and a pasta of conger eel and karasumi. Wine runs to organic bottles. It fills up most evenings, so book; portions are modest. Open daily from 15:00 to midnight.

osaka_naniwa_robata_toyo_kobayashi_namba.notes: [Izakaya · Namba, robata and seafood a minute from the station] A lively robatayaki izakaya steps from Namba station, opened in June 2025 by the Osaka 十忠八九 group of seafood izakaya. Sit at the first-floor counter to watch the fish turn over the grill (one couple was sent to a third-floor tatami room and missed it). Diners single out the fresh, thick-cut sashimi, the grilled kinki and fish of the day, and scallops grilled in the shell whose juices come back with a small rice ball; Awaodori chicken with rock salt, rare liver with chives and oden fill the gaps. The drinks list is long and prices fair, but tables are limited to two hours when busy. Menus in English, Chinese and Korean, and on many nights much of the room is overseas guests. Book ahead; open daily 16:00–23:00.

osaka_moegi_uranamba.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:15); dinner 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Opened 20 September 2019 (Tabelog).
osaka_moegi_uranamba.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Ura Namba, negiyaki down a back alley] Down an Ura Namba alley that one diner would have turned back from if alone, a cosy wooden room with a counter and tables, several with their own teppan, and a queue at opening time. The house speciality is negiyaki, fluffy and charred, finished with dashi soy sauce instead of thick sauce; the okonomiyaki is cabbage-heavy with a light dashi batter, and the yakisoba leans on bonito rather than sauce, a lighter style that one Sapporo visitor missed. Start with teppan plates (salt-grilled Kaga lotus root, bacon-wrapped scallops, horumon) and end with a crepe of okonomiyaki batter filled with bean paste and ice cream. A comedian, Miki, is said by an October 2026 diner to recommend it. Many guests are overseas visitors, so book for dinner; closed Wednesdays.

osaka_kitaya_honten_minamisenba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery (breads, sandwiches, curry bread, French breads; some of the wheat is new-season Tokachi wheat, October 2026). Nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_kitaya_honten_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain breads such as the domestic-wheat French bread may suit, but most breads are filled or enriched (butter, cream, cheese, mentaiko, ham, egg); nothing is labelled vegan.
osaka_kitaya_honten_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00; Sat 08:00–16:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). The official site gives 08:00 until sold out, closed Sundays and holidays; long summer breaks (20 July–17 August 2025 and 19 July–16 August 2026, official site). Takeaway only (Tabelog); coffee can be had outside (September 2026). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). A very small shop, one or two customers at a time (May and June 2026). A free rusk for following the shop on Instagram (June–October 2026); a handwritten monthly newsletter (official site; October 2026).
osaka_kitaya_honten_minamisenba.notes: [Bakery · Minami-Senba, a couple's neighbourhood bakery since 2000] A small, house-like shop among the office blocks of Minami-Senba, so small that customers take turns inside, run by a couple whose warmth regulars mention as much as the bread. A childhood friend of the founder, writing in June 2026, says the founder opened it in 2000 after cooking Spanish food and now runs it with a Spanish spouse. The long-standing star is the curry bread of curry simmered for a day; the mentaiko French is timed to come out mid-morning, and there is a monthly special announced in a handwritten newsletter (bitter-melon curry one summer, sakura anpan in spring, stollen at Christmas). Loaves can be bought by the slice, and following the shop on Instagram gets you a rusk. Opens at 08:00, closes when sold out; closed Sundays and for a month in summer.

osaka_pommier_nipponbashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the dishes people come for are breaded and fried (katsudon, chicken katsu, kara-age, shrimp fry) in a dashi-and-soy sauce; no gluten-free option described.
osaka_pommier_nipponbashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is built on pork, chicken and egg, with miso soup and dashi.
osaka_pommier_nipponbashi.hours_raw: Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:00–17:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). osaka_pommier_nipponbashi.notes: [Donburi · Nipponbashi, the big-portion café] A café-looking room near Den-Den Town that is famous for portions: the regular katsudon (¥1,550 in 2026) comes on 400 g of rice under a cutlet and a mound of soft egg that spills over the bowl, and the large and the 800 g versions are for competitive eaters. Order a half or small rice if unsure; diners in 2026 saw others leave food behind. The oyakodon and the kara-age set are the other favourites, and a single kara-age is ¥200. Write your name on the board by the door, ideally before 11:00; cash only; closed Thursdays.

osaka_ibuki_coffee_kuromon.hours_raw: Daily 7:00–18:30, last food order 18:00; closed only on 1 January (Tabelog). No reservations; cash only, no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog; August 2026). A few seats at the front and about eight tables for four further in (May 2026). Breakfast sets (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). osaka_ibuki_coffee_kuromon.notes: [Kissaten · Kuromon Market, open from 7 a.m.] A wood-panelled Showa coffee shop inside the Kuromon Market arcade, quiet and classical-music calm when the market outside is packed. The coffee is dark and strong, poured to the brim with sugar cubes on the side (¥590 in 2026); come early for a morning set of egg toast or an egg-and-cucumber sandwich, or later for a marron cake. Iced drinks are made sweet or unsweet as you ask. Staff hand out an English menu to visitors (July 2026). Cash only; open every day but 1 January.

chef_bio.background: A June 2026 reviewer writes that the shop began as a branch of Marufuku Coffee and was renamed after the surname of a previous owner; an October 2026 reviewer mentions a "main branch" where the strength can be chosen, and a May 2026 reviewer wonders about a link to an Ibuki Coffee in Tenma. These are reviewers' statements, not checked against another source. The official site sells house-roasted beans, drip bags and bottled coffee.
chef_bio.specialty: Dark-roast hot coffee; egg-toast morning set.

anecdotes.text: "At first, the staff brought me an English menu, perhaps because there are many tourists in the area" — July 2026, an egg sandwich and iced café au lait at 9:30.
"The coffee was incredibly strong—much stronger than I remembered from Marufuku. … It also came with four pieces of rare cube sugar." — June 2026.
"From the outside, it seemed like there were few seats, but as I went further inside, I discovered about eight spacious four-person tables." — May 2026, hot coffee for JPY 590.

osaka_vourke_nambanaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The sweets are tiramisu, beignets (fried dough), pudding, brownie and pancakes, and the light meal is a croque monsieur; the pudding is the item without obvious flour, but nothing is stated about it.
osaka_vourke_nambanaka.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Black coffee is the plain option; the tiramisu, pudding, beignets and croque monsieur use dairy and eggs.
osaka_vourke_nambanaka.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–20:00, open all year (Tabelog). No reservations; order and pay at the counter first, then sit; tables are shared when full, and Saturday afternoons from 14:00 are packed (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog); a pet-friendly terrace (August 2026).
osaka_vourke_nambanaka.notes: [Café · Nambanaka, tiramisu and beignets] A wood-and-dried-flower café on a quiet street a few minutes from Nankai Namba, with a wooden deck and a terrace where dogs are welcome. Order at the counter: the homemade tiramisu (peach in late summer 2026) and the beignets, fried dough split around tiramisu cream or seasonal fruit (fig, ¥1,350 in August 2026), are what diners come for, with a coffee (¥650). The pudding sells out. Weekend afternoons are crowded and tables get shared.

chef_bio.background: An August 2026 reviewer describes VOURKE as the second shop of HOOD by Vargas in Nakatsu, Osaka (not checked elsewhere). The staff suggested a brownie instead of beignets after a meal to a September 2026 diner.

osaka_takitani_hanten_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Chinese dishes in soy-, bean-paste and chili sauces: mapo tofu, yodare chicken, shrimp mayo, spring rolls, shumai, dandan noodles; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_takitani_hanten_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the mapo tofu has minced meat (June 2026), and the menu is built on chicken, seafood, lamb and beef.
osaka_takitani_hanten_shinmachi.hours_raw: Lunch Tue, Wed, Thu and Sat 11:30–14:00 (mapo tofu set on Tue, Thu and Sat; dandan noodles on Wednesday, per August 2026 reviews); dinner Tue–Sun 17:30–22:00; closed Monday and the second Sunday of each month (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; busy nights may mean the counter (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats: 4 at the counter and 26 at tables, a semi-private room for up to 25; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Sources differ on staffing: a May 2026 diner saw staff running a busy weekend efficiently; a July 2026 diner calls it a one-person operation, so food can take a while.
osaka_takitani_hanten_shinmachi.notes: [Chinese · Shinmachi, the mapo tofu house] A modest-looking Chinese restaurant in Shinmachi whose chef, with 30 years behind the stove, is proud of the mapo tofu: numbing, meaty and balanced rather than salty. At lunch it is the only dish (Tue, Thu and Sat, ¥1,200 with free rice refills; dandan noodles on Wednesday). At dinner, order the yodare chicken, the Chinese-style sashimi of the day with vegetables and nuts, shark-fin spring rolls and the mapo tofu to finish. Book on weekend nights; expect ¥4,000–8,000 a head at dinner. Closed Mondays and the second Sunday.

osaka_ichiban_ramen_higashinakajima.notes: [Chinese · Higashinakajima, a machi-chuka by the Shin-Osaka east exit] A small, old-style neighbourhood Chinese restaurant a couple of minutes from the east side of Shin-Osaka Station, run by a team of women (September 2025; June 2026). The name says ramen, but most diners come for the kara-age: huge, crisp and loaded with garlic, so the owner steers pairs to the half order (June 2026). Around it go spicy gyoza, liver and chives, garlic fried rice and sweet-and-sour pork, all fast and cheap, nine dishes for four at ¥8,900 in July 2026. The shoyu ramen (¥900, March 2026) and a beef-bone shio ramen close the night for business travellers, and it fills up when a Shinkansen is delayed (September 2025). Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

osaka_pariwar_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Naan, baked in the tandoor, comes with every set; rice is offered too, but how the curries are thickened is not described.
osaka_pariwar_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks "vegan options", "vegetarian options", "halal options" and "Hindu options", and a vegetable curry appears in the daily sets (2026); nothing on the menu is labelled vegan, and the sets come with naan, chicken tikka and kebab.
osaka_pariwar_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00, lunch until 14:30; open all year (Tabelog). Free refills of curry and naan at lunch (11:00–14:30) on Mondays and Fridays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR payments including Alipay (Tabelog). 28 table seats; non-smoking, with ashtrays outside; children welcome, kids menu; English menu; takeaway and delivery; free Wi-Fi; one parking coupon for the Times or NPC lots by the station per ¥1,000 spent (Tabelog). Moved here from an earlier site (February 2026 review).
osaka_pariwar_shin_osaka.notes: [Indian · Higashinakajima, curry and naan by the Shin-Osaka east exit] An Indian-Nepali curry house a few minutes from the east exit of Shin-Osaka Station, easy to spot by the tuk-tuk parked out front and a loud sign beside a well-known ramen shop, with Indian TV on a big screen inside (May 2026). Lunch is the deal: sets around ¥900–950 of a big tandoor naan and two daily curries, some with chicken tikka and kebab, and on Mondays and Fridays the curry and naan are refilled free (Tabelog; 2026). The shop picks the curries, often a keema and a vegetable one; staff adjusted the heat for a child (August 2026). Reviews are mixed: some praise the chewy naan and value, others found the curries thin and the naan hard once cold (February and June 2026). Open every day to 22:00.

osaka_shanshan_kaku_higashinakajima.notes: [Chinese · Higashinakajima, a Sichuan-leaning diner east of Shin-Osaka] A roomy neighbourhood Chinese restaurant on the east side of Shin-Osaka Station, open since 2018, where the staff chat in Chinese and the food comes in two or three minutes (June 2026). Office workers come for the ¥1,000 lunch sets: a big plate of mapo tofu, more fragrant than fiery, with rice, soup, salad and two garlicky kara-age, refills included. At night it turns into a drinking spot with gyoza, mapo eggplant, water spinach and an all-you-can-eat-and-drink plan for about ¥5,000, and one diner comes monthly for it (June 2026). The owner is quick and friendly. Smoking is allowed inside. Closed Sunday.

osaka_jigen_higashinakajima.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Higashinakajima, a neighbourhood teppan east of Shin-Osaka] A small okonomiyaki counter a few minutes from the east gate of Shin-Osaka Station, where the owner, with "that classic Osaka uncle vibe" (August 2026), cooks okonomiyaki, modern-yaki and a much-liked horumon yakisoba on the griddle in front of you. Lunch is short, 11:30 to 13:00 or until the rice runs out, and a horumon yakisoba set is under ¥1,000 (August 2026); come by noon. In the evening it is an easy drinking spot: modern-yaki, negiyaki and teppan snacks with highballs for under ¥5,000 a head (February 2026). The house has firm ideas about how to eat: one April 2026 pair loved the food but were told to stop chatting and leave after an hour. Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Tuesday.

osaka_stand_kuma_kun_r25_sonezaki.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Umeda, a chicken-sashimi standing bar] A standing bar on the Ohatsu Tenjin shopping street, opened in October 2025 by the people behind the yakitori restaurant Kuma no Yakitori (October 2026 review), that serves raw and barely seared chicken from Kagoshima farms. Order by QR code at the counter: the toro-momo tataki, thigh seared with a burner in front of you and dressed with a sweet sauce and onion, the silky breast sashimi, liver, wing sashimi, and a limited cubed sashimi with pickled cabbage, most around ¥500–1,100 (October 2026). Fries, an egg onigiri and a sea-urchin rice fill the gaps, and an hour of all-you-can-drink is ¥980. It opens at 14:00 at weekends, closes on Wednesdays, and shuts early if the chicken runs out. One regular has been sixteen times; another found it pricey for what it is (October 2026).

osaka_yakitori_masaru_shoten_sonezaki.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–5:00 (last order 5:00); Sundays last order 3:00, opening time not listed; closed 24 December and 1 January and some other days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; courses need a phone booking (September 2026). Private-room charge ¥230, included in course prices (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 77 seats with counter, tatami and sunken seating and private rooms for 4 to 20, renovated in July 2025; smoking allowed (Tabelog). osaka_yakitori_masaru_shoten_sonezaki.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Umeda, binchotan yakitori until dawn] A big, relaxed yakitori house a minute from Higashi-Umeda Station near Ohatsu Tenjin, open since 2012 and until 5:00 most nights, with private rooms for four to twenty added in a July 2025 renovation. Chicken comes daily from a local poultry shop and is skewered in generous pieces and grilled slowly over Tosa binchotan; the dashimaki is a house favourite. Groups book the ¥4,500 binchotan course with ninety minutes of drinks: chicken tataki, seven skewers, butter-steamed Awaji onion, fried chicken and a chicken zosui to finish (August 2026). A July 2026 diner praised the big skewers and a chicken-broth ramen to end; others found the service stretched on busy nights. Smoking is allowed.

osaka_oryori_nagumo_shibata.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, shio-koji fried chicken, fried eggplant in dashi and kamameshi; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_oryori_nagumo_shibata.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seasonal seafood, fried chicken and dashi-based dishes; a fruit salad with white sesame and a tofu salad are the vegetable plates, unexplained.
osaka_oryori_nagumo_shibata.hours_raw: Daily 16:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations through the booking form linked on the shop's Instagram, open 24 hours; seat-only bookings pay a ¥400 starter charge (before tax), course bookings ¥300 seat charge (before tax) (Tabelog). Often fully booked (March and June 2026). No children; no coat check, bags go in a basket at the table (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 seats upstairs with tatami and three private rooms, the largest for 12; a standing bar on the ground floor (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Non-smoking (Tabelog). No draft beer (May 2026). Opened 7 August 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_oryori_nagumo_shibata.notes: [Izakaya · Umeda, a tatami izakaya under the Hankyu tracks] A Japanese izakaya on the upper floor of a narrow space under the Hankyu Umeda elevated tracks, opened in August 2025 above its own standing bar; diners say the entrance is easy to miss (May and August 2026). Upstairs is a tatami room with three private rooms, where trains rumble overhead now and then. The kitchen sends out Osaka seafood and seasonal dishes: thick-cut sashimi, bonito tataki, a peach and white-sesame salad and, the dish every reviewer names, shio-koji fried chicken; finish with sea-bream or eel kamameshi. Courses start at ¥3,300 for groups, and a ¥6,000 plan adds two hours of sake and shochu. Book through the shop's Instagram form; it is often full. No draft beer, and no children.

osaka_yumiba_shinnosuke_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. One omakase of ten dishes with dashi soups, fried sweetfish with house Worcestershire sauce, somen and soy-based sauces.
osaka_yumiba_shinnosuke_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki of seafood, eel, beef, game and dashi.
osaka_yumiba_shinnosuke_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat two seatings, from 18:00 and from 20:30; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservation only; the person who booked must attend; arriving late or leaving early may mean fewer dishes; whole-shop hire for 10 to 12, children welcome then (Tabelog). Course price includes the 10% service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Twelve seats at a U-shaped counter; non-smoking; no perfume; menu in English, Chinese and Korean (Tabelog). Bento to order (October 2026).
osaka_yumiba_shinnosuke_kitashinchi.notes: [Kaiseki · Kitashinchi, a twelve-seat counter of temperature and aroma] A small kaiseki counter on the seventh floor of a Kitashinchi building, thirty seconds from the station, where the young owner-chef Yumiba Shinnosuke, who trained at Ogurano and went independent in 2021 (July 2026 review), serves one ten-course omakase designed around serving each dish at its best temperature and aroma (Tabelog). Expect Kitamurasaki sea urchin over eggplant, Numajima eel and matsutake in a clear bowl, sweetfish fried with its own liver, braised Ozaki beef, and two kinds of rice to finish, at about ¥20,000 with service. Regulars note the chef's steady growth and easy conversation, and a July 2026 diner mentions a Michelin selection. One August 2026 diner could not eat the bear meat on the course, so ask about game when booking. Two seatings a night; no perfume.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yumiba Shinnosuke (弓場慎之佑; romaji from the Tabelog listing)
roles: Owner-chef
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: Japanese cuisine "that won't tire you out until the last bite", valuing the temperature of dishes and the aroma of ingredients; a 10-course omakase of seasonal ingredients; "a chef dedicated to culinary arts, weaving a food culture for the future". Per a July 2026 review: the chef trained at "Ogurano", became independent in 2021 and is still in the thirties per that diner, and the restaurant is Michelin-selected; per an October 2023 review, the chef and the chef's wife ran the restaurant.
chef_bio.philosophy: "The temperature that brings out the best in the dishes" and "the aroma of ingredients we want to deliver to our customers" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Ten-course omakase; two kinds of rice to finish.

anecdotes.text: "With each visit, the quality of the dishes has improved, and now it's a place I can confidently recommend to others." — July 2026, a fourth visit.
